name: Quorlyx
author: mouhcine1st

sections.description:
Quorlyx adds an AI chatbot widget to your site and provides admin tools to configure its behavior, appearance, and optional content workflows.

Key features:

  • Chatbot widget with customizable persona and styling
  • Engagement triggers (free build limited to 1 trigger)
  • Logs and admin tools to help troubleshoot
  • Content generation tools (requires your own provider API key)

External Services

This plugin can connect to third-party AI providers if you configure an API key and enable those features.

When the chatbot is used (or when you fetch available models in the admin), the plugin sends message content to the selected provider to generate responses.

Depending on which features you use, your WordPress site may send one or more of the following to the selected provider:

  • Chat messages entered by a site visitor (and prior chat history)
  • If “Knowledge Base Post Types” are enabled: snippets of site content used as context (titles/excerpts/URLs)
  • For Schema/Links tools and Content Engine generation: post content and/or generation prompts

Services/endpoints the plugin may connect to (depending on the provider you choose):

  • api.openai.com (OpenAI)
  • generativelanguage.googleapis.com (Google Gemini)
  • api.anthropic.com (Anthropic)
  • api.x.ai (xAI)
  • api.mistral.ai (Mistral)
  • api.deepseek.com (DeepSeek)

Provider policy links:

  • OpenAI: Privacy https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/ — Terms https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/
  • Google (Gemini): Privacy https://policies.google.com/privacy — Terms https://policies.google.com/terms
  • Anthropic: Privacy https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy — Terms https://www.anthropic.com/legal/consumer-terms
  • xAI (Grok): Privacy https://x.ai/legal/privacy-policy — Terms https://x.ai/legal/terms-of-service
  • Mistral: Privacy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/privacy-policy — Terms https://legal.mistral.ai/terms
  • DeepSeek: Privacy https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-privacy-policy.html — Terms https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-open-platform-terms-of-service.html

The external service is only contacted when:

  • A site visitor uses the chatbot, or
  • An administrator fetches available models from the provider.

Privacy / Cookies

The plugin may set first-party functional cookies and/or use browser storage to:

  • Keep a guest identifier for conversation continuity (cookie: quorlyx_guest_id)
  • Support optional A/B variation stickiness when enabled (cookie: quorlyx_ab_variation)
  • Prevent repeating engagement triggers within the same session (cookie/session keys like qu_v_* and sessionStorage entries)
  • Track “thank-you page reached” for trigger logic (cookie: quorlyx_thankyou_reached)

If your site requires it, disclose this in your site’s Privacy Policy.

Development / Source

This plugin ships production assets in the dist/ directory (including minified JS/CSS).

For review and human-readable source access, equivalent readable copies are included in:

  • src/js/
  • src/css/

These files are provided so the distributed/minified assets can be inspected in an easy-to-read format.

To regenerate the src/ copies from dist/ (optional), run:

  • powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/generate-sources.ps1
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/quorlyx/ directory, or install through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Quorlyx -> Settings -> Chatbot and configure a provider and API key.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin send data to Quorlyx servers?

No. The plugin connects directly from your WordPress site to the AI provider you select.

Do I need an API key?

Yes. You must provide your own AI provider API key to generate responses.
